correctness.rationale: The derivative is reconstructed explicitly, the maximum coordinate norm is the exact largest signed row sum, and tail Cauchy–Schwarz is equality-attaining without leaving the box. Segment integration gives all-input upper bounds; interior sign perturbations approach the extremal derivative and prove sharpness. The two asymptotic statements follow from the closed formula. The decoded standalone verification script has separately passed 124715 deterministic assertions; these computations supplement rather than replace universal analytic proof. One-dimensional and singleton cases are explicitly excluded from the nontrivial formula.

value.rationale: The nontrivial, naturally motivated invariant is the exact two-input maximum-coordinate sensitivity of positive unit-vector normalization under lower and upper dynamic-range bounds. Its sharp extremizer undergoes a dimension-six/seven structural transition, and a second contrast saturation frontier distinguishes fixed-contrast decaying sensitivity from growing-contrast nonzero limits. Those precise thresholds and equality configurations inform robust error budgets for the zero-offset normalization component, unlike an arbitrary parameter substitution or generic derivative estimate. No downstream training guarantee is claimed.
